name: Koala AI
tagline: Koala AI produces SEO-optimised articles with one click by combining GPT-4o with real-time SERP data. It analyses what's currently ranking for a keyword and generates structured articles with proper headings, FAQs, and internal linking suggestions. It also includes a chat interface for content brainstorming.
